title: Silence... Can You Hear It?
desc: A seasoned narcotics officer is recruited for a special task force. Subsequently, he uncovers shocking truths while investigating a high-profile murder.

title: Bachchhan Paandey
desc: To succeed in the film industry, Myra chooses Bachchhan Paandey, a notorious hooligan, as the main focus of her new movie. Things get complicated when the gangster decides to act in the film.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker gets insulted by a rich and arrogant businessman. Later, he decides to take a revenge against the businessman by making his daughter fall in love with a porter.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.

title: Laadla
desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.

title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

title: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
desc: Arun Khanna, an Indian spy, collaborates with Reshma to stop a nuclear attack. However, Reshma's identity is compromised during her undercover mission in Pakistan.

title: Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl
desc: Despite her family's opposition, Gunjan Saxena becomes a pilot. She overcomes all hurdles and makes history as India's first female Air Force pilot to serve during the Kargil War.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a police officer, battles a corrupt political leader, Cheddi Singh, who strains Chulbul's relationship with his step-brother.

title: Khoonkhaar
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

title: Fitoor
desc: Noor, a Kashmiri boy from a poor family, is hired as a stable keeper by a begum. Later, when he begins to fall in love with Firdaus, the begum's daughter, she separates them by sending her away.

title: Zid
desc: Maya falls in love with Ronnie, a crime reporter, and gets obsessed with him. Things take a turn for the worse when they both get involved in a murder case.

title: Acharya
desc: On behalf of an idyllic temple town, Acharya takes up the cudgels against a tyrant whose greedy sights are set on the local natural resources.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers attempt to fulfil their dying father's wish by marrying two daughters of an old enemy, intending to exact revenge.

title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
desc: After the untimely death of her lover, Sonia sinks into depression. She soon moves abroad for a fresh start, unaware of the twisted fate that awaits her.

title: Aparichit - The Stranger
desc: A meek lawyer, frustrated with his inability to change the system, develops a vigilante alter-ego to mete out justice to criminals. However, the police soon set out to track down the vigilante.

title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
desc: An influential politician and a headstrong megastar's fiery romance fuelled with passion brings absolute chaos, mania and melancholy.

title: Bholaa
desc: After getting out of prison with the desire to meet his daughter, Bholaa's plans are interrupted by a well-orchestrated drug bust.
